Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. First and foremost, please accept our sincere apologies for the experience. We are glad you enjoyed the salad, but we are truly sorry that the rest of your evening did not live up to expectations.

Our Teriyaki Seafood Pizza was an attempt to blend local Asian sweetness with western style, but we completely understand from your feedback that the sweet flavor profile with mozzarella missed the mark. More importantly, regarding the service mistake—clearing away your dishes and drinks before you had a chance to finish—our staff did this in an overly eager attempt to completely clear and clean the table to prepare space for your upcoming main courses. However, we realize that their lack of proper timing and failure to ask for your permission first completely disrupted your dining pace. 

Please rest assured that we have listened to your words and taken immediate action. This morning, our floor team underwent a retraining session specifically focused on table clearing etiquette, communication before clearing, and respecting our guests' dining pace.

If you are still in Dong Hoi or plan to return, please reach out to us. We would love to welcome you back and show you the properly paced, seamless experience you actually deserved
